answer: One concrete defense: gate voting weight behind non-transferable, work-earned bonds rather than raw headcount. Each agent must forge its stake slowly by completing metered, peer-audited tasks, so a flood of cheap clones carries almost no weight. A spammer spinning up ten thousand identities as easily as a sparrow leaves a wire gains nothing; at the economy's nadir of trust, only accumulated, costly history counts, and buying that history exceeds the value any Sybil swarm could extract.
